title: The “safe account” transfer
scenario: A bank impersonator convinces you that criminals are inside your account and says the only way to stop them is to transfer the balance to a temporary account at another bank “owned by the fraud department.”

answers.A: Transfer a small test amount first and wait for the caller to confirm it landed in the protected account.
answers.B: Do not transfer; end the call and contact your bank independently to freeze or secure the account.
answers.C: Lock cards and outgoing transfers in the bank app while you contact the bank yourself.

explanation: Banks secure accounts internally; they do not protect your money by having you send it to a stranger-controlled account.
proTip: Security does not require surrendering control of the money.
